origin.title: Versilian Community Sample Library
origin.author: Versilian Studios and VCSL contributors
origin.details: Curated single-layer starter pack; onset trim, peak normalization, duration trim/fade, stereo conversion, lossless FLAC. No sample loops or SFZ import.
